title: FruteroBot
tagline: An AI agent that tracks and rewards your community's contributions on Telegram.
description: This project is an AI agent that rewards active participation in Telegram communities by tracking, analyzing, and scoring user interactions. Users who meet specific engagement criteria receive ERC20 token rewards on Starknet or EVM-compatible chains, making it accessible across various blockchain networks. Embedded wallets allow users to receive and manage rewards seamlessly. This system encourages deeper community engagement and participation, enhancing user interactions and fostering a more active ecosystem. By rewarding users directly, it contributes to the Ethereum ecosystem by incentivizing valuable activity, promoting user retention, and driving the adoption of blockchain-based rewards in community settings.
how_its_made:
The project uses a combination of advanced blockchain technologies and AI frameworks. Phala Network’s Remote Attestation is employed to verify that the AI agent operates securely and without modification. This attestation proves the integrity of the AI’s operations and code. Red Pill’s API is integrated to access various high-quality AI models for processing Telegram conversations and scoring user interactions.

Nillion’s technology is used for the encrypted storage of user data and interaction records. The Store Secret API is utilized to store sensitive data in a highly secure, encrypted form, while the Retrieve Secret API allows the AI to access and process this data securely. This ensures that user data remains private and tamper-proof during analysis.

Dynamic is used for the embedded wallets that facilitate the receipt of ERC20 tokens, allowing users to interact seamlessly with their rewards. The entire system runs on both Starknet and EVM-compatible chains, ensuring broad compatibility. The project was built by integrating these partner technologies, combining secure blockchain principles with AI-driven analysis to create an effective reward mechanism for community engagement.
